brief:
Palestinian police raided the residence of retired Maj. Gen. Adnan al-Damiri in Tulkarm, Shehab Wire reported, marking an apparent rupture between the security establishment and a figure who previously justified security force actions as an official spokesman. The operation triggered mutual accusations over the use of force and house search procedures.

The raid revived scrutiny of al-Damiri's earlier positions during his tenure as spokesperson, when he defended aggressive security measures. His prior statements had aligned with the Palestinian Authority's security posture, contrasting sharply with his current complaints against police conduct.
